in_latin.name: Natala
in_latin.meaning: Natalis, a festive name, derived from natalis dies, the birthday or anniversary of a person
in_latin.long_meaning: Natala: Festiva nomen, a festive name, derived from natalis dies, the birthday or anniversary of a person, from natalis, birth, and dies, day, originally a noun, used to describe a day of celebration, a festival day, in early Christian tradition, Natala was used to signify the birth of Christ, and later became a popular name for girls, symbolizing joy, hope, and new life
